abstract: The clinical records of 47 patients with testicular seminoma treated between 1973 and 1984 were reviewed. The mean age was 41 years. There were relatively few blacks and patients of mixed race--4% and 17% respectively. The incidence of associated testicular maldescent was statistically significantly higher among the black and mixed-race patients (40%) than among the white patients (8%). Forty-three patients underwent retroperitoneal irradiation after orchidectomy, with a 5-year survival rate of 87% at a median follow-up of 52 months. There were no relapses at follow-up in 27 stage I patients; 1 of 8 patients with stage IIA and B (non-bulky) disease relapsed after 12 years, and relapses occurred in all 5 patients with stage IIC (bulky) seminoma. Retroperitoneal and mediastinal irradiation has controlled disease in 2 patients with stage III disease without bulky metastases. One patient with stage IV seminoma treated with irradiation relapsed. One of the patients with stage I disease has developed a major bowel complication following 3,000 cGy fractionated irradiation. Our experience with cis-platinum-based chemotherapy includes noting its effectiveness in a patient with unresectable locally advanced testicular seminoma. We recommend retroperitoneal irradiation after orchidectomy for patients with stage I and IIA/B disease and cis-platinum combination chemotherapy after orchidectomy for those with more advanced disease.
abstract_ja: 1973年から1984年の間に治療された精巣セミノーマ47例の診療記録を後方視的に検討した。平均年齢は41歳であった。黒人および混血患者は少なく、それぞれ4%、17%であった。精巣下降不全の合併率は黒人および混血患者(40%)で白人患者(8%)より統計学的に有意に高かった。43例が精巣摘除術後に後腹膜照射を受け、中央値52か月の追跡で5年生存率は87%であった。病期I患者27例では追跡時に再発はなかった。病期IIA/B(非腫瘤性)病変の8例のうち1例が12年後に再発し、病期IIC(腫瘤性)セミノーマの5例すべてに再発がみられた。後腹膜および縦隔照射は、腫瘤性転移のない病期III患者2例で病勢をコントロールした。放射線療法で治療された病期IV患者1例が再発した。病期I患者1例は、分割照射3,000cGy後に重篤な腸合併症を発症した。切除不能な局所進行精巣セミノーマ患者1例において、シスプラチン併用化学療法の有効性が確認された。精巣摘除術後の病期Iおよび病期IIA/Bには後腹膜照射を、より進行した病期には精巣摘除術後のシスプラチン併用化学療法を推奨する。
